phase_name: Production readiness — task 22 CLI contract and explicit measured limits

Record the resolved task-22 tracker answer and map pointer

remaining_tasks.name: Enforce capacity and performance evidence in CI; decide whether measured limits should be rebaselined

blockers.description: The Node 24 ceiling run passes every recorded latency metric but measures 272.46 MiB attributable RSS against the approved 256 MiB ceiling; a repeat Node 22 run reports open p95 1043.671 ms against the 1000 ms standard budget.
blockers.workaround: Repeat the same seeded ceiling benchmark multiple times on clean supported Linux Node 22 and Node 24 runners, then rebaseline only with an explicit evidence-backed decision.

blockers.description: The repository's npm command path resolves to the broken external shim /mnt/c/Users/bulky/node_modules/.bin/node, whose payload is the literal text 'This file intentionally left blank'.
blockers.workaround: Use the installed absolute Node 22.23.0 or Node 24.17.0 binary and direct Vitest/benchmark entry points until the external shim is repaired. npm ci --ignore-scripts completed successfully.

human_actions_pending.action: Approve a new capacity/performance baseline only after the repeat-run evidence is reviewed.
human_actions_pending.context: Task 22 has no product latency budget of its own. The explicit budgets belong to tasks 09/14/23; changing them would reopen the resolved contract decision and alter the release gate.

decisions.decision: Treat task 22 as resolved and do not reopen its CLI implementation for the capacity discussion.
decisions.rationale: The complete CLI suite passed under Node 24: 16 files and 202 tests, with merge tests 14/14 and merge-integration tests 16/16. Capacity limits are owned by the capacity/performance contract.

decisions.decision: Keep the approved limits unchanged until reproducible supported-matrix evidence justifies a revision.
decisions.rationale: The available evidence is mixed: Node 24 is over the RSS ceiling and Node 22 is slightly over the open standard budget, while single-run latency values are not sufficient to establish a new p95 contract.

decisions.decision: Use direct absolute Node binaries for verification in this worktree.
decisions.rationale: The external npm/node shim is invalid, but Node 22.23.0 and Node 24.17.0 are installed and usable directly.

next_action: Resume by running a clean, repeated ceiling benchmark on Linux Node 22 and Node 24 with seed 42; compare p95 latency, attributable RSS, and exact capacities before proposing any limit increase.
context_notes: No GSD phase directory or PLAN.md exists, so this is a default-context handoff centered on tracker task 22. Task 22 is complete; the open frontier is task 23. Do not confuse the 60,000 ms Vitest test timeout used for the CLI suite with a product performance limit. Preserve the user's uncommitted package, test, benchmark, and diagram artifacts.
